note: THE DRY GULCH, wave 20, no river, seams pay 1.4x — the richest purse of the three contracts, so the answer is simply MORE WORKS. Seven pieces issued at the gate, 445 gold total, inside what the pan can raise in 600s. THE TRIGGERS ARE STRICTLY INCREASING AND THAT IS LOAD-BEARING: the executor skips a BUILD whose condition is unmet and fires the next one that IS met, so a cheap order low in the list jumps the queue and lands on an unstaged mouse. Monotone triggers make list order and firing order the same thing. Opening beacon at 30 buys damage while the first turret is still being paid for, then turrets at 62/88/130/180 and beacons at 105/155 interleaved so the damage curve rises continuously instead of in one lump. Each trigger carries ~12 gold over its cost (25/50/70/35/95/45/125) — about 2.6s at this map's pan rate, the walk-and-park the reflex layer needs. Cells are spread across the working middle rather than pinned to whichever seams are live this minute: seams cycle, and the reflex layer now stands on whichever seam is PAYING and aims at the closest legal approach to my cell. No FALLBACK_IF — on The Claim its threshold went permanently true and quietly became a HOLD that starved the pan.
